findings.reason: without a frozen additive-rule arm (or a restated comparator) the node that lands §4 cannot evaluate the section's own gate, and its gain goes unmeasured.
findings.text: §3 says "The tool arm calls the product ranking" (line 179, so a later section "measures its own head") and, two lines later, that "the current additive rule [is] among [the harness arms], so the baseline survives §4", yet the arm enumeration (lines 154-155, and line 173's "the five arms") names exactly five arms — current tool, vector only, RRF, and both reranks — with no frozen additive-rule arm, and the landed harness (`tests/llm/test_signal_search_goldens.py:244-247`) implements the `current_tool` arm by calling `_rank_signals` live; once §4 rewrites `_rank_signals` to use fusion, the "current tool" arm *is* fusion, so §4's done-when ("fused signal search beats the current tool on mean nDCG@10", §4 line 239) compares fusion against itself and cannot hold
